title: Civic Ledger — Open-Data Portal Statement
description: A paired-panel government dashboard setting a choropleth map against ranked bar data in the spare, authoritative register of GOV.UK and data.gov.kr — distinguished by its single-typeface discipline and bottom-right CC license commitment.
philosophy: Civic data earns public trust through restraint, not decoration. This template refuses gradients, drop shadows, and brand-color exuberance in favor of a single typeface, two weights, and a near-white ground that positions the data — not the institution — as protagonist. It is designed for the public servant who must communicate statistical reality to a press gallery, parliamentary committee, or skeptical civil-society audience. The CC license stamp at bottom-right is not a footnote; it is a constitutional declaration about who the data belongs to.
goodFor: Regional statistics briefings for press or parliamentary audiences
Open-data portal landing decks for government digital services
Geographic comparisons pairing a choropleth with a ranked bar series
Public-sector annual report openers requiring institutional authority
avoidFor: Consumer product launches expecting visual energy and brand-color variety
Corporate keynotes requiring multiple accent colors across chart series
Presentations where decorative illustration or full-bleed photography anchors the layout
Dense multi-panel BI dashboards with more than two simultaneous chart types
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a government statistical release cover — calm, earned authority rather than branded confidence. Compositional rhythm is deliberately asymmetric: dense typographic weight on the left gives way to an airy, de-saturated geographic form on the right that implies the data's scope without narrating it. The near-white ground is the loudest design choice; every element floats within it rather than being contained by panels or strokes. Avoid any decorative geometry, tonal gradients, or illustrative flourish — the restraint itself signals institutional credibility.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with a generous outer margin (~9%) on all sides; title and subtitle block occupy cols 1–7, left-aligned and vertically centered in the upper-left quadrant. A large ghosted choropleth silhouette bleeds in from the right edge (cols 7–12), serving as the sole visual anchor without framing or border treatment. A thin horizontal rule separates the title from a one-line deck descriptor beneath it — hierarchy driven by weight contrast and that single rule alone. CC license stamp is fixed to bottom-right corner; no header band or institutional logo strip.

examples.promptCore: The slide radiates the measured authority of a parliamentary statistical release — spare, trustworthy, deliberately unshowy. The choropleth and ranked-bar panels sit in quiet equilibrium, neither competing for dominance, allowing the geographic gradient and the ranked sequence to narrate together. Composition breathes through generous white ground rather than crowding data into corners. Avoid any illustrative flourish, shadow, or tonal gradient; the only visual energy is the data itself contrasting against the near-white field.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with a 6% outer margin and a thin 1px rule separating a header band from the body. Body splits into two equal panels: left panel holds the choropleth map flush to the center gutter, right panel stacks ranked horizontal bars top-to-bottom with inline data labels flush-right. A slim footer band carries the CC license stamp pinned to bottom-right and a slide counter to bottom-left. No decorative chrome between panels — the gutter rule alone marks the division.
